capture.announce: 🔴 Recording **{channel}** for meeting notes. Everyone in this voice channel is recorded per speaker and transcribed locally. Use `/meeting stop` to end it.
capture.busy: I'm already connected to a voice channel in this server (for example via `/voice join`). Run `/voice leave` first, then start the recording again.
capture.discord_only: Live recording works only from Discord.
capture.incompatible: Live recording is disabled: this Hermes version changed voice internals the scribe relies on ({detail}). Run `hermes meeting-scribe doctor`.
capture.join_voice_first: Join a voice channel first, or pass one: `/meeting start #voice-channel`.
capture.no_guild: Run this inside a Discord server channel (not a DM).
capture.not_connected: Discord is not connected yet; try again in a moment.
capture.stopped: ⏹️ Recording stopped ({reason}). Meeting `{id}` is being processed; notes will be posted here.
capture.target_not_found: No voice channel “{target}” in this server.
capture.timeout: Discord did not answer in time; check `/meeting status`.
cli.setup_google: Google Meet import: enable it now? You will need an OAuth client JSON (see README → Google Meet) [y/N]:
cli.setup_intro: meeting-scribe setup — press Enter to keep the value in brackets.
cli.setup_language_hint: Pinning the spoken language is strongly recommended: auto-detect can flip mid-meeting.
cmd.capture_unavailable: Live recording is not available in this installation yet (capture module not installed). Processing, search and reprocess work.
cmd.help:
**/{cmd}** — meeting scribe
`start [#voice]` record · `stop` finish · `status` · `list [n]` · `show <id>` · `search <text>` · `reprocess <id> [from=transcribe|analyze|deliver]` · `link @user <linear email or name>` · `project <id> <project>` · `config` · `help`
cmd.project_saved: Meeting `{id}` assigned to project “{project}”; channel mapping learned.
cmd.reprocess_bad_stage: Unknown stage `{stage}`. Use transcribe, analyze or deliver.
cmd.reprocess_no_audio: Imported meeting (no audio): re-analyzing its transcript instead of re-transcribing.
google.connect_intro: Open this URL in a browser signed in to your Google Workspace account and grant read access to Meet:
google.connect_paste: After consenting, paste the full URL of the page you were redirected to (it may fail to load; that is fine) or just the code:
google.connect_waiting: Waiting for the browser redirect (up to {minutes} min)...
google.connected: ✅ Google connected. New Meet transcripts ending after now will be imported{extra}.
google.enable_hint: once you run `hermes meeting-scribe config set google_meet_enabled true` (and restart the gateway)
google.no_client: Google: no OAuth client stored. Pass --client-secret <file.json> (Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client, type Desktop app).
google.not_connected: Google: not connected. Run `hermes meeting-scribe google connect --client-secret <file.json>`.
google.reconnected: ✅ Google reconnected. Meet transcripts ending after the first connection ({since}, at most 30 days back) that are not imported yet will be imported{extra}.
google.status_connected: Google: connected (scope meetings.space.readonly; the account is not read).
google.status_disconnected: Google: disconnected — access was revoked or expired. Run `hermes meeting-scribe google connect` again.
google.sync_report: Listed {listed} conference(s): {imported} imported, {already} already imported, {pending} transcript(s) not ready yet, {none} without transcript.
notes.partial: Recording was interrupted; notes may be incomplete.
sink.linear_inactive: Linear is not connected (no LINEAR_API_KEY and no allowlisted `linear` MCP server).
tasks.dm_failed: Could not DM {users} (DMs closed); use 📋 My tasks.
tasks.kanban_owner_tasks: Kanban is the owners' personal board: it is only offered on their own tasks.
tasks.legacy_moved: ↪️ These tasks now live in their project threads; see the task index.
tasks.moved: Moved to {channel}; tasks named “{project}” will go there from now on.
tasks.no_permission: I cannot post in {channel}; the tasks are here
tasks.owners_only_unassigned: This task has no assignee; only owners can act on it.
tasks.panel_empty: You have no tasks in this meeting.
tasks.unknown: Task {item} was not found (maybe the meeting was reprocessed).
transcript.no_permission: 📎 The full transcript could not be attached here (missing **Attach Files** permission). It is still available with `hermes meeting-scribe export`.
transcript.title: Transcript — {title}
transcript.too_large: 📎 The transcript is too long to attach ({parts} parts). Use `hermes meeting-scribe export` to get it.
ui.no_projects: No projects available (Hermes projects, Kanban boards or Linear).
ui.not_allowed: You are not allowed to use these buttons.
ui.owner_only: Only meeting owners can send tasks to Kanban.
ui.pick_project: Pick the project for this meeting:
ui.project_saved: Project set to “{project}”; this channel will default to it from now on.
